name: Naomi
summary: Elimelech's widow who loses her husband and both sons in Moab; she returns to Bethlehem with her daughter-in-law Ruth and arranges Ruth's marriage to Boaz.

name: Ruth
summary: A Moabite widow who vows loyalty to her mother-in-law Naomi, gleans in Boaz's field, and becomes his wife; her son Obed is King David's grandfather.

name: Orpah
summary: Naomi's other Moabite daughter-in-law; unlike Ruth, she kisses Naomi goodbye and returns to her own people and gods.

name: Elimelech
summary: Naomi's husband, who moves the family from Bethlehem to Moab during a famine and dies there; his land is later redeemed by Boaz.

name: Mahlon
summary: One of Elimelech and Naomi's two sons; he marries Ruth in Moab and dies there, and Boaz later redeems his inheritance by marrying his widow.

name: Chilion
summary: One of Elimelech and Naomi's two sons; he marries Orpah in Moab and dies there like his father and brother.

name: The Women of Bethlehem
summary: The town's women who are stirred by Naomi's return, then celebrate the birth of Obed and bless the LORD for giving Naomi a redeemer.

name: Boaz
summary: A worthy relative of Naomi's husband Elimelech; he shows Ruth kindness in his field and, as a family redeemer, marries her and buys back Elimelech's land.

name: The Nearer Redeemer
summary: An unnamed relative of Elimelech with a stronger right of redemption than Boaz; he declines to redeem the land once he learns it requires marrying Ruth, and transfers his right to Boaz.

name: The Elders and People at the Gate
summary: The ten elders and townspeople Boaz gathers as witnesses to the redemption of Elimelech's land and his marriage to Ruth.

name: Obed
summary: Son of Boaz and Ruth, nursed by Naomi as her own; he is the father of Jesse and grandfather of King David.
